label: E1c (DRAFT, not frozen): verified-ID hybrid vs prose, both directions
max_starts_note: one start plus one infrastructure retry. The retry needs results/<stage>/e1c_state.json to carry a retry authorisation (tools/authorise_retry.py) with a reason in infra_retry_reasons, written after inspecting the failed attempt's log; never after .done, BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, CANARY_FAIL or ATTEMPT_INCOMPLETE. Budget is cumulative across both attempts.
seed_rule: Each book is built with 2 x core_per_family core entries per family; the E1c core is the first n per family in build order whose rule text is new. If a book fails to build at its pinned generator seed, the seed is raised by 100 until it builds; every attempt is logged. Dev: generator 91062 built first try (80/family; data/dev_seed_attempts.txt). TEST: about 3 of 10 throwaway seeds build at TEST size, so the rule is expected to fire; tools/build_book.py applies it mechanically.
verifier_batch_rule: D1 compares the batch-8 production verifier path with batch 1 on 16 entries per model. If any reply differs for either model, T1 is NOT eligible: an amendment must add a new dev stage that re-measures the acceptance screen with the verifier at batch 1 (the effective batch is in the protocol hash). There is no automatic switch.
